standard-dialogue-with-an-amulet-of-ghos.npc: Don't you know? I am a proud Knight of the Lion, serving under the Justiciar of the Lion.
And you are the adventurer who disturbed my rest!

standard-dialogue-with-an-amulet-of-ghos.player: Yeah... I'm not really all that sorry about that. I was searching for Hallowed marks. Although I didn't actually intend to disturb you if that's any consolation.

standard-dialogue-with-an-amulet-of-ghos.npc: Hallowed marks? That currency is reserved only for the devout followers of holy Saradomin. Are you a follower, adventurer?

steps.text: If the player has at least one Saradomin item equipped:

steps.npc: I see! Yes, I can sense that you at least carry some items bearing his symbol. Well met fellow follower! Do tell, what is the Justiciar of the Lion up to these days?

steps.player: The Justiciar of the Lion? I've never heard of them.

steps.npc: By Saradomin's mercy! Are you serious adventurer? You've never heard of her glory?
The statue in the south east bears her resemblance. I remember the day it was built in her honour.
The Justiciar of the Lion is a title bestowed upon the most powerful wizard of our order. She was capable of wiping out an entire army of Zamorakian demons with a single spell!
I lament that I could not learn more from her in life but I do not regret for a single instant following her to my grave.

steps.player: I see, she sounds like an inspirational figure indeed. Do you know where I can find her?

steps.npc: I was hoping that you could tell me. Last I heard, she was residing in the college here in Hallowvale.

steps.player: Never mind, you don't want to know.

steps.text: If the player has no Saradomin items equipped:

steps.npc: You lie adventurer. I do not sense a single item of holy Saradomin on your person.
To think that our currency is being handled by non- followers. It's a disgrace! If I weren't dead, I'd incinerate you where you stand for your impudence!

steps.player: Yeah well, you are dead and I have your currency so you're going to have to... live with that!

steps.npc: I don't appreciate your attempts at humour, non- follower.
To think that our currency is being handled by non- followers. It's a disgrace! If I weren't dead, I'd incinerate you where you stand for your impudence!

steps.player: Yeah well, you are dead and I have your currency so you're going to have to... live with that!

steps.npc: I don't appreciate your attempts at humour, non- follower.

upon-opening-a-coffin-in-the-hallowed-se.npc: You dare defile this sacred place? That treasure doesn't belong to you!
